name: cdk-bluejay-eks-platform-ts-componentize
instr:
The Bluejay CDK app builds every resource directly in three long stack constructors, so nothing in it is reusable. Please split it into components.

Each component is a `Construct` exported from `lib/components/<class-name-in-kebab-case>.ts`, sitting at the given path under its stack, props in parentheses. Props use `lib/config.ts` types (`settings` is one entry, lists are `string[]`, `workloads` and `nodePools` are name-keyed config maps unless noted) and take aws-cdk-lib constructs as `I` interfaces (`ec2.IVpc`); public properties are read-only, concretely typed, and `fooBar` is the child `FooBar` unless noted. `NetworkStack` gets `FoundationNetwork` at `Network` (`cidr`, `availabilityZones` as names, `natGateways`, `flowLogGroup`) exposing `vpc`; `FlowLogArchive` at `FlowLogs` (`project`, `stage`) exposing `logGroup`; `AvailabilityZoneTelemetry` at `Zones/<zone>` (`project`, `stage`, `name`, `settings`) exposing `deliveryLogGroup` (`DeliveryLogs`), `natAlarm` (`NatErrors`), holding `Priority`, `Configuration`; `NetworkInventory` at `Inventory` (`project`, `stage`, `zones`, `settings` for all zones) holding `PrimaryAz`, `Inventory`. `SecurityStack` gets `ClusterAccessBoundary` at `ClusterAccess` (`vpc`, `operationsCidrs`, `dnsCidrs`, `ntpCidrs`) exposing `controlPlane`, `apiProxy`; `NodeNetworkBoundary` at `Nodes` (those four, `vpcCidr`, `controlPlane` and `ingress` groups, `nodePort`, `availabilityZones`, `nodePools`) exposing `nodeBase`, `nodeStandard`; `IngressBoundary`
